brief: Andrew figures prominently only in John’s Gospel. There he is one of the first two followers of Jesus and the one who introduces his brother Simon Peter to Jesus. He presents to Jesus the boy with loaves and fishes to be used in the feeding of the multitude. Later he alerts Jesus to the interest of some Greeks in him. He is, then, as characteristic an apostle as any. We have no information about him after the resurrection, though he became the patron saint of Scotland.
